description: During the 2026-05-14 morning vision walk, the operator clarified that reference scenarios should no longer be treated as semi-independent hand-patched exemplars when the underlying scenario templates are expected to generate working valid scenarios immediately. Old model: patch reference scenario, then maybe backport general fixes to template. Desired model: fix the template first, regenerate or refresh reference scenarios from the template, and use those generated references as validation targets for template quality. Update relevant meta-optimization, reference-pattern-fitness, and toolchain-validator guidance so agents do not dual-maintain template and reference scenario drift. Acceptance: docs/skills clearly state that template defects are fixed in templates first; reference scenarios are regenerated/refreshed for validation; any exception to hand-patching a reference scenario must be explicit and justified.
name: prompt-manager-reference-scenario-template-guidance
title: Update Prompt-Manager reference-scenario guidance for template-generated validation
